title: A/P Detail: Totals follow the vendor, Past due and Location filters
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have three new vendors (created for this test) with only these open documents on today's date:
  • Vendor A: a bill of $1,000.00 at location A 15 days past due, a bill of $400.00 at location B 45 days past due and an unused vendor credit of $150.00 at location A.
  • Vendor B: a bill of $700.00 at location A 45 days past due and a bill of $250.00 at location B 100 days past due.
  • Vendor C: a bill of $900.00 at location A 5 days past due.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Vendor filter, tick vendor A and vendor B.
  2. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days".
  3. Expand every group and read the rows and the Totals row.
  4. In the Location filter, untick location B.
  5. Expand every group and read the rows and the Totals row.
  6. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  7. Open the PDF and read its Totals row.
  8. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  9. Open the CSV and read its Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Only the two vendors' documents remain.
  • Vendor C's $900.00 is gone.
  • The Totals row's Open Balance reads $2,200.00 (1,000.00 + 400.00 − 150.00 + 700.00 + 250.00): the Totals row follows the vendor filter.

Step 2:

  • The chip reads "Past due: 31-60 days".

Step 3:

  • The rows are the $400.00 and $700.00 documents (45 days past due) and the $150.00 vendor credit, which is always kept.
  • The Totals row reads $950.00 (400.00 + 700.00 − 150.00).

Step 4:

  • The report narrows to location A.

Step 5:

  • The rows are the $700.00 document and the $150.00 vendor credit.
  • The Totals row reads $550.00 (700.00 − 150.00).

Step 6:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 7:

  • The PDF's Totals row reads $550.00, the same as the screen.

Step 8:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 9:

  • The CSV's Totals row reads $550.00, the same as the screen.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
  • S5-R16: “With ranges ticked, A/R Detail, A/R Collection, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices keep only the invoices and bills whose days past due on the as-of date fall in a ticked range, and always keep credit memos, deposits and vendor credits.”
  • S5-R7: “Choosing locations narrows every row, group, subtotal, total, page count, sort and export to the open documents at those locations. A row belongs to the location of its own document. On A/R: the invoice, credit memo or deposit. On A/P: a bill belongs to the location of the delivery it was received on; a vendor credit from a vendor return belongs to that return's location; any other vendor credit keeps its vendor's location, as today. That is the location the Location column shows.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-past-due-ticked.png: figure "Past due ticked" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p7-call-list-on-a-r-collection.png: figure "Call list on A/R Collection" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p4-one-location-ticked.png: figure "One location ticked" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • "31-60 days and 91+ days ticked: the chip reads "Past due: 2 ranges" in blue. The Summary lists only customers with an amount in those ranges, at full balances; the Totals row adds up exactly these rows. S5-R15, S5-R16, S5-R17, S5-R18, S5-R19." (caption of "Past due ticked")
  • "Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a." (caption of "Call list on A/R Collection")
  • "One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1." (caption of "One location ticked")
